content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

This is not a workaround. It’s a complete commerce stack built on sovereign infrastructure. The core components are GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Each piece is independent, open, and under your control. The system works like this: a buyer sends crypto to your payment address. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain. Once confirmed, Cloudflare Workers triggers product delivery via a secure link. The entire process is automated, instant, and doesn’t require a third-party platform. Why does this matter? Because it removes the single point of failure that platforms like Stripe introduce. When you own the infrastructure, no one can shut you down, restrict your region, or change the rules mid-game. This is commerce architecture built for permanence, not permission.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the technical breakdown. The storefront is hosted on GitHub Pages — a free, globally distributed platform. When a buyer selects your Notion template, they’re redirected to a NOWPayments invoice. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. Once payment is confirmed on-chain, a webhook fires to Cloudflare Workers. This serverless function verifies the payment, logs the order in Supabase, and generates a secure, expiring download link. The link is sent to the buyer’s email using Cloudflare’s email API. The template file itself is stored in Cloudflare R2 — a low-cost, high-performance object storage solution. No databases are exposed, no files are left unsecured. Every step is automated, from payment verification to product delivery. The system is designed to handle scale without manual intervention. You deploy it once, and it runs indefinitely.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you’re selling Notion templates, ebooks, courses, or software in Kenya, Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or similar markets, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent their commerce infrastructure. When you use Stripe or PayPal, you’re leasing access to a system that can revoke your privileges at any time. With this stack, you own the codebase, the data, and the deployment. There are no monthly fees, no transaction limits, and no geographic restrictions. The system is designed to work in the hardest markets — places where currency collapse, payment rejection, and financial isolation are real threats. It’s not just a tool; it’s a statement of infrastructure sovereignty.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure removes platform dependency permanently.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in this stack serves a specific purpose. GitHub Pages provides static hosting for your storefront. It’s free, fast, and integrates seamlessly with GitHub’s version control. Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic — payment verification, order logging, and link generation. It’s serverless, meaning you pay only for what you use. Supabase, a PostgreSQL-compatible database, stores order data securely. Cloudflare R2 stores your digital products, ensuring fast, reliable delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, converting USD prices to the chosen cryptocurrency at transaction time. The email delivery system uses Cloudflare’s API, ensuring high deliverability rates. All these tools are either free or low-cost, with no hidden fees. Together, they form a stack that’s greater than the sum of its parts. Each component is replaceable, but the default configuration is optimized for speed, security, and cost-efficiency.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your product flow. Identify the Notion templates you’ll sell, set your prices in USD, and decide which cryptocurrencies to accept (BSC, Solana, and TRON are recommended for low fees). Next, deploy the storefront to GitHub Pages. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for pre-built templates and step-by-step guides. Configure NOWPayments to generate invoices and fire webhooks. Connect Cloudflare Workers to handle payment verification and product delivery. Set up Supabase to log orders and Cloudflare R2 to store template files. Test the entire flow end-to-end before going live. Once deployed, promote your store to your audience. The system will handle payments, deliveries, and order tracking automatically. You focus on creating; the infrastructure handles the rest. This isn’t a temporary fix — it’s a permanent solution to a permanent problem.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell Notion templates for crypto without Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. The buyer pays in crypto, NOWPayments verifies the transaction, and Cloudflare Workers automates product delivery via a secure link. The entire system is serverless, region-independent, and under your full control. No platform fees, no geographic restrictions, and no single point of failure.
Crypto payments via NOWPayments ensure instant, global transactions with no KYC.

It’s the fastest way to launch a sovereign commerce stack without starting from scratch. Every component is documented, every integration is pre-configured, and every deployment is yours to own. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Map your product flow: Identify templates, set USD prices, choose cryptocurrencies (BSC, Solana, TRON recommended).
2. Deploy storefront: Use GitHub Pages with pre-built templates from the Complete Builder Kit.
3. Set up payments: Configure NOWPayments for invoices and webhooks.
4. Build backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers to verify payments and trigger deliveries.
5. Store data: Set up Supabase for order logging and Cloudflare R2 for file storage.
6. Test end-to-end: Simulate purchases to ensure every step works flawlessly.
7. Launch: Promote your store and let the infrastructure handle the rest.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-built templates and step-by-step guides. While basic technical understanding helps, the kit is designed for non-developers to deploy successfully.
What if crypto prices fluctuate?
NOWPayments converts USD prices to crypto at transaction time, locking in the rate. Fluctuations after purchase don’t affect your revenue.
How secure is the file delivery system?
Files are stored in Cloudflare R2, and download links are secure, expiring after a single use. No direct access to storage is exposed.
What are the ongoing costs?
GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase’s free tier are sufficient for most creators. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. Cloudflare R2 costs are minimal.
Can I add more products later?
Yes. The system is designed to scale. Add new products by updating your storefront and backend logic — no need to rebuild the entire stack.
Deploy once, own forever — no subscriptions, no geographic restrictions.
